headline: Zero cycle. In Bishkek, construction companies had their licenses suspended and were fined
summary: Authorities suspended the licence of a construction company and imposed fines after an inspection of a 16-storey residential complex on Michurin Street in Bishkek.
why: Construction firms depend on operating licences to win and complete projects, so suspensions affect developers, contractors and local housing supply.
original_headline: Нулевой цикл. В Бишкеке стройкомпании приостановили лицензию и оштрафовали
